purpose: Reduce the selected electroweak C1 primitive response to the single index-weighted local determinant/analytic-torsion source.

torsion_curvature.reason: Direct gravitational/torsion curvature is not gauge-factor-labeled; non-universal torsion effects enter through the selected determinant operator.

bundle_index.reason: Group/Dynkin/charge indices weight determinant thresholds; without a selected determinant/spectrum, they do not define a standalone threshold amplitude.

remaining_physical_source.meaning: Selected index-weighted, torsion-dependent local determinant/analytic-torsion response in the fixed gauge-factor basis.

verdict.next_required_computation: Compute the selected index-weighted local determinant response, or at minimum its U1-SU2 difference.
